tools.name: list_traits
tools.description: Lists the 15 social and emotional learning (SEL) traits Life Scenario practises, each with a plain-language description and the everyday skills it covers. For questions about what a trait means for a child aged 6–14.

tools.name: find_practice_situation
tools.description: Finds up to 3 public Life Scenario practice scenarios for a real-life situation a child is facing (for example: left out at recess, peer pressure, cheating in a group chat, parents arguing, a new school). Returns each scenario's title, a short excerpt, the ages it is written for, the traits it pract

tools.name: get_what_to_say
tools.description: Finds the published Life Scenario "What to say" guide for parents that best matches a topic (for example: "nobody will play with me", "being teased") and returns its short answer, the key lines a child can say, its URL and, when the guide has one, a practice_url: a practice scenario on a similar sit

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Factual overview of Life Scenario: what the SEL practice game for children aged 6–14 does, what it is not, how child safety is handled, what this server can and cannot see, and key links.
